about.body: An Information Systems graduate focused on fullstack web development. I break business problems into logical system flows, then build them into stable, usable applications. From user research to deployment, I handle the full development cycle with Laravel, Node.js, Vue.js, and MySQL.

highlights.title: Through to production

dawn-six.title: Dawn Six
dawn-six.subtitle: WhatsApp Broadcast & Crowdsourcing Platform
dawn-six.summary: A commercial web platform for automated WhatsApp broadcasts and crowdsourced task distribution, with real-time device session management.
dawn-six.cardDescription: WhatsApp broadcasts and crowdsourced task distribution in one flow.
dawn-six.context: The client needed one platform to run automated WhatsApp broadcasts and distribute crowdsourced tasks. Device sessions also had to be monitored from the application.
approach: Designed the relational database structure with the team.
Built backend logic and user management flows in Laravel 11.
Integrated a Node.js WhatsApp gateway with the Baileys SDK through REST API.
dawn-six.outcome: Broadcasts and task distribution moved from manual processes into one application flow connected to the WhatsApp gateway.
dawn-six.note: The repository is private. System screenshots and architecture walkthrough are available during a technical interview.

spk.title: SPK Weighted Product
spk.subtitle: Decision Support System
spk.summary: A web application that applies the Weighted Product method to calculate multi-criteria weights and produce decision rankings.
spk.cardDescription: Multi-criteria ranking with the Weighted Product method.
spk.context: Scoring against many criteria needs consistent weight rules. The system stores criteria, weights, and alternative scores, then calculates rankings with the Weighted Product method.
approach: Analyzed system requirements and mapped the criteria processing flow.
Translated the Weighted Product formula into PHP backend logic.
Built the criteria management and results interface with JavaScript and Bootstrap.
spk.outcome: Rankings are calculated from the weights and scores entered, so the same scoring rules can be reused.
spk.note: No public demo link is available for this project yet.

coffee-exporter.title: Coffee Exporter Profile
coffee-exporter.subtitle: Coffee Exporter Company Profile
coffee-exporter.summary: A responsive company profile website for an Indonesian coffee exporter, built to strengthen B2B credibility and give prospective international partners access to the product catalog.
coffee-exporter.cardDescription: A coffee exporter company profile with a scannable product catalog.
coffee-exporter.context: Prospective international partners need a quick view of the products and the company identity. The site is a lightweight entry point with a catalog that works on mobile and desktop.
approach: Designed a responsive layout for a range of screen sizes.
Managed deployment to Vercel and Netlify.
coffee-exporter.outcome: The company profile and product catalog are accessible across screen sizes, with assets optimized for loading.
coffee-exporter.note: No public demo link is available for this project yet.

harmasentech.title: HarmasenTech
harmasentech.subtitle: Digital Agency Web Profile
harmasentech.summary: The official website for a digital agency, covering custom web application development services, company profile, and API integrations.
harmasentech.cardDescription: A digital agency website with a deployment flow straight from GitHub.
harmasentech.context: The agency needed an official page to explain custom web application development, its company profile, and API integrations to prospective business clients.
approach: Built a modern, responsive page structure.
Set up a continuous deployment flow from GitHub to Vercel.
harmasentech.outcome: The site runs at harmasentech.web.id and updates through a continuous deployment flow from the GitHub repository to Vercel.

bullets: Build end-to-end web applications for business clients and team projects with Laravel, Node.js, JavaScript, and MySQL.
Develop a WhatsApp broadcast automation and crowdsourced task distribution system connected to REST APIs and the Baileys SDK.

Contribute to relational database design, authentication systems, and code workflows with Git.
Conducted user research and processed survey data to support the development of a job-seeking platform.
Mapped user needs and pain points into recommendations for feature flow and interface improvements.
Prepared structured documentation and analysis reports as decision references for the development team.
